body.voice_description: Create an original voice for an eager puppy chess companion, performed by an adult female voice actor in a bright, spunky animated-sidekick register. Light, small, quick voice with buoyant puppy eagerness: delighted upward reactions that settle into a clear, sincere explanation. Crisp energetic consonants, natural words, no squeak, falsetto strain or baby talk. Fluent English at a normal conversational pace, about eight to ten seconds. Clear words and a fully finished final phrase. Clean dry studio sound, one voice, no music or animal noises. An original fictional adult voice, never an imitation of a named actor or character.
body.text: Oh, there it is! That move leaves a piece with no defender. Let's check the reply together, then try to keep that piece protected.
